overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for OsloMet: headings map correctly, learning outcomes keep all three sub-groups, and arbeidskrav land in coursework_requirements. Remaining problems are exam-logistics and regulation boilerplate inside assessment, admission text in prerequisites, placeholders, and one truncated prerequisites list. Most pre-pass leak flags (leak->learning_outcomes/teaching_methods) are false alarms from words like 'Kunnskaper'.

findings.evidence: Kalkulatoren skal utgjøre en enkelt gjenstand og ha lommeformat.
findings.description: The 'Hjelpemidler ved eksamen' heading is mapped to assessment, so the permitted-aids text (calculator rules, 'Ingen', 'Se egen hjelpemiddelliste') is appended to assessment as exam logistics rather than assessment design. It also leaves bare fragments like 'Ingen' and 'A til F'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps 'Hjelpemidler ved eksamen' (and 'Vurderingsuttrykk') to assessment instead of .drop.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Hjelpemidler ved eksamen' to .drop (or strip it in .clean_sections()) for OsloMet, keeping Vurderingsuttrykk if the grading scale is wanted.

findings.evidence: Studentens retter og plikter ved ny/utsatt eksamen fremgår av forskrift om studier og eksamen ved OsloMet.
findings.description: Generic regulation boilerplate (rights and duties at resit exams, Skikkethetsvurdering pointer to external URL) sits inside assessment. Not assessment design.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Text under 'Vurdering og eksamen' is kept whole; the 'Ny/utsatt eksamen' sub-heading is only dropped when it is a separate heading, and 'Skikkethetsvurdering' is unmapped so it joins assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Skikkethetsvurdering' to .drop and add a .clean_sections() line filter for 'ny/utsatt eksamen' regulation sentences.

findings.description: Prerequisites section emitted with the placeholder 'Ingen info' (the pre-pass 'empty' flag is real). Same placeholder ends assessment in MSLV4500-1. Also 'Ingen arbeidskrav/obligatoriske aktiviteter.' as coursework_requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No placeholder filter for 'Ingen info' / 'Ingen.' in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Ingen info' to the placeholder patterns so the row is not emitted (also trailing 'Ingen info' in assessment).

findings.evidence: Bestått første og andre studieår eller tilsvarende i bachelorstudium i bioingeniørfag, eller
findings.description: The plan lists two alternatives; the second ('Opptak til kompletterende utdanning for bioingeniører') is lost, so the extracted requirement ends in a dangling 'eller'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Page has no blank line between the list items and the next heading; the last line is probably swallowed as a heading or dropped as admission text.
findings.suggested_fix: Inspect the blocks for this page and check that the last list line before 'Læringsutbytte' is not treated as a heading or admission .drop.

findings.evidence: Søkere som Utdanningsdirektoratet har vurdert til å ha lærerutdanning
findings.description: Forkunnskapskrav here is pure admission text (opptakskrav, priority at admission, general study competence), not prerequisites per the codebook. Flag leak->.drop is real in the sense that it mirrors the dropped 'Målgruppe og opptakskrav' content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading 'Forkunnskapskrav' is mapped to prerequisites regardless of content.
findings.suggested_fix: Optionally drop paragraphs starting with 'Opptakskrav' / mentioning 'prioritert ved opptak' / 'generell studiekompetanse' in prerequisites.

findings.evidence: Vedtatt i avdelingsstyret. Godkjent av rektor.
findings.description: Governance boilerplate ('Vedtatt i avdelingsstyret. Godkjent av rektor...') at the start of course_content. Also table-of-subjects noise ('Genetikk og molekylær diagnostikk 15 stp') at the end of BIOB3210 course_content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Text under Innledning is kept in full.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a line filter for 'Vedtatt i ... Godkjent av rektor' in .clean_sections().
